title: trond status output
description: Returned by `trond status <node> -o json`. Combines stored state with a best-effort live probe of the node's HTTP API.

last_applied.description: Timestamp of the last apply that modified state.

block_height.description: Latest block the node has processed; only present when status=running and the live HTTP probe succeeded.

peer_count.description: Number of currently connected peers; only present from live probe.

is_synced.description: True if block_height >= the network's perceived head. Derived from the same probe; absent if the probe failed.

genesis_block_id.description: The chain's identity fingerprint: the TRON block id of block 0 (64-hex), from a live getblockbynum probe. Constant for the chain's lifetime; lets an agent tell private rigs apart and correlate on-chain. NOTE: this is the TRON block id (its first 8 bytes encode the block number, 0 for genesis — not the raw header hash), and it is NOT the TVM CHAINID value (which is flag-dependent). Live-only: absent when the node is stopped/unreachable, like block_height.

network.description: The network this node was deployed on (mainnet | nile | private). Empty for nodes deployed before this field was recorded.

is_private.description: True when network is 'private' — a self-contained chain safe for an unattended agent to mutate. Lets an automated caller PROVE a rig is private before acting. False when network is empty/unknown (fail-safe).

build_cache_key.description: Content-addressed cache key of the source build that produced this node's artifact (`<gitrev:12>-b<digest>[+dirty-...][-x...]`). Present only when the node was built from source (intent build: block); absent for pre-built image/jar nodes.

build_revision.description: Resolved source git revision (short, 12-hex) the node was built from — the leading segment of build_cache_key, surfaced separately so an agent knows which java-tron commit is running without parsing the compound key. Present only for source-built nodes.

healthy.description: Liveness only: true when status=running AND the live getnowblock probe returned a REAL block (non-zero block timestamp — an empty or error-shaped 200 does not count). It means 'the RPC is serving blocks', NOT that the node is fully synced — use is_synced and block_height for sync health (healthy can be true while is_synced is false on a node whose tip is stale). False when stopped, unreachable, or the probe was skipped (fail-safe). Always present.

container_id.description: Full 64-hex docker container ID backing this node (runtime=docker, best-effort). Lets an agent attach/exec against the exact container. Absent for jar nodes or when the docker daemon can't be reached.

logs.description: Runtime-discriminated locator telling an external log consumer (e.g. mcp-logs) how to read this node's logs without screen-scraping. For runtime=docker, read `path` inside `container` via `docker exec`. For runtime=jar, read the systemd `unit`'s journal via `journalctl -u`.

path.description: log file path INSIDE the container (runtime=docker).

unit.description: systemd unit whose journal carries the logs (runtime=jar).

lag.description: Block delta between local height and the highest height the node has seen across peers; only present from live probe.

monitoring.description: Prometheus + Grafana stack ports for nodes deployed with --monitor. Host is implicit: 127.0.0.1 for local targets, target.host for SSH. NOTE: unlike inspect output's monitoring object, this shape carries a live probed `status` instead of an `enabled` flag.

prometheus_port.description: Host port the Prometheus container is bound to.

grafana_port.description: Host port the Grafana container is bound to.

status.description: Best-effort health of the monitoring stack (docker compose ps state); 'unknown' when the stack can't be reached.

probe_error.description: Set when the live probe couldn't reach the HTTP API (timed out / refused). status fields from state.json are still present.
